model: EC fans with MODBUS Lite (series 84/112/150/200 Lite)
applies_to: ebm-papst EC fans and motors whose electronics report the MODBUS Lite parameter set (series 84 / 112 / 150 / 200 Lite), specification V5.01.
summary: ebm-papst EC fans with MODBUS Lite electronics expose a common Modbus RTU parameter set on RS485. Live values (speed, status and warning bits, DC-link voltage/current, temperatures, power) are input registers from D000; settings such as set-value source, set value, control mode, address and serial format are holding registers. Speed, voltage, current and power are scaled against per-fan reference registers, so read those first.

addressing.note: Addresses are printed in hex and are the register address sent in the frame; the manual's own example telegrams write D149 as bytes D1 49 and trigger Adopt parameters with 06 D0 00. Input and holding registers both start at D000 but are separate tables.

source.title: MODBUS parameters ebm-papst series 84 / 112 / 150 / 200 Lite (MODBUS Lite Basic Functionality V5.01)
source.pages: Holding registers ch. 2 (pp. 24-61), input registers ch. 3 (pp. 62-70)

notes: Encoding: the document states parameters are big endian (high byte first). All registers listed here are single 16-bit values.

Speed values use 64000 = Maximum speed (D119); DC-link voltage and current use reference values D1A0 (20 mV steps) and D1A1 (2 mA steps); power uses both. Those registers carry raw values with scale 1 and the formula in the description.
Bit positions in Motor status (D011), Warning (D012) and Reset (D000) were read from the column layout of the encoding tables (MSB = bits 15-8, LSB = bits 7-0).

Left out: module temperature (D015) because the document gives no signed/unsigned format for it, unlike the motor and electronics temperatures; P/I factors, modulation limits, potentiometer curve, fail-safe, derating, error history, password, sensor scaling and production data.
Many holding registers need a password at a given authorisation level (write it to D002-D004); this map lists the customer-level settings an integrator normally touches.

registers.name: Identification
registers.description: Electronics/protocol type code; see the identification table in the source.

registers.name: Maximum number of bytes
registers.description: Largest telegram the fan accepts.

registers.name: Software version of bus controller
registers.description: Version in the low byte; high byte is 0.

registers.name: Actual speed
registers.description: rpm = raw x nMax / 64000, where nMax is Maximum speed (D119). Capped at 0xFFF0.

registers.name: Motor status
registers.description: Errors currently detected; FB is set with every error.

registers.name: Warning
registers.description: Pre-alarm conditions.

bits.10: Cable break at analogue set value input

registers.name: DC-link voltage
registers.description: V = raw x reference Uz (D1A0) / 256.

registers.name: DC-link current
registers.description: A = raw x reference Iz (D1A1) / 256.

registers.name: Current modulation level
registers.description: Percent = raw x 100 / 65536.

registers.name: Current set value
registers.description: Speed control: rpm = raw x nMax / 64000, where nMax is Maximum speed (D119). PWM control: % = raw x 100 / 65536.

registers.name: Sensor actual value
registers.description: Voltage at the analogue input = raw x 10 / 65536.

registers.name: Current power
registers.description: W = raw x reference Uz x reference Iz / 65536.

registers.name: Reset
registers.description: Bits clear themselves once executed.

bits.3: Full software reset (comms drop for seconds)

registers.name: Default set value
registers.description: Set value when source is RS485. Speed: raw = rpm x 64000 / nMax; PWM: raw = % x 65536 / 100.

registers.name: Operating hours counter
registers.description: Stops at 65535. Only ebm-papst level may write it.

registers.name: Operating minutes counter
registers.description: Only ebm-papst level may write it.

registers.name: Fan address
registers.description: 1-247, low byte.

registers.name: Save set value
registers.description: 1 also stores D001 in EEPROM (limited to 100,000 writes).

registers.name: Maximum speed (nMax)
registers.description: Reference for all speed values (64000 = nMax).

registers.name: Transfer rate
registers.description: Applied after Adopt parameters/Reset or power cycle.

registers.name: Parity configuration
registers.description: Applied after Adopt parameters/Reset or power cycle.

registers.name: Reference value of DC-link voltage
registers.description: Raw x 20 mV; used to scale D013 and D021.

registers.name: Reference value of DC-link current
registers.description: Raw x 2 mA; used to scale D014 and D021.

integration.summary: Read D119 (nMax) and D1A0/D1A1 once, then poll input registers D010-D021 with function 04. To run the fan from Modbus set D101 = 1 and write the set value to holding register D001.
integration.enable: Write Source set value D101 = 1 (RS485) so the fan follows Default set value D001 instead of the 0-10 V input.
integration.watchdog: A fail-safe function can apply a separate set value and running direction when the Modbus connection breaks (sections 2.35-2.38 of the source); it is not mapped here.
quirks: Do not enable Save set value (D103) if D001 is written often; the EEPROM allows about 100,000 writes.
The 4 least significant bits of the set value are ignored.
New baud/parity settings only apply after 'Adopt parameters' (D000 bit 1), a reset or power cycle.
setup: Recommended/standard serial format: 19200 baud, 8E1. Changing D149/D14A needs at least customer-level password.
Emergency function: after 10 bad telegrams the fan falls back to 19200 8E1, after 10 more to 2400 8E1, which helps find an unknown setting.
Fan address is set in D100 (1-247).
gotchas: Input and holding registers overlap in address (both from D000); use function 04 for live values and 03 for settings.
Selecting 8N1 breaks the 11-bit frame rule of the Modbus serial specification; prefer 8E1 or 8N2.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
